name: DnaJ heat shock protein family (Hsp40) member C21

function.text: DNAJC21 encodes dnaJ homolog subfamily C member 21. Annotated molecular activities include zinc ion binding. It participates in protein folding.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to bone marrow failure syndrome 3 (autosomal recessive).
